# A statement at the root of a file resolves names against that file's own
# imports, whichever file of the package pass1 happened to finish on. The
# package body used to be checked in the scope of the last file read, so
# `time.timer` in app.sngl was undefined because z.sngl, sorted after it,
# imports no `time`.

sngl check .
stdout 'app.sngl: ok'

-- app.sngl --
import time "sngl:time"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var n = 0

time.timer(interval=200ms, @tick {
    n += 1
})

ui.window(title="Main") {
    ui.text(value="{n}")
}
-- z.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

var m = 0
